lines.text: The next day, every outlet in the Ark begins reporting on the incident.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Today we have a shocking accident to report.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Missilis Industry's ongoing Project Matis resulted in numerous casualties yesterday.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: According to those close to the project, heat levels spiked during the second round of body production,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: causing all of the participants to tragically melt inside their capsules.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: There are rumors that the former CEO, Enme, had previously deemed this project unfinished and ordered it to be scrapped,

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: raising questions as to whether this accident was a result of CEO Syuen conducting a reckless experiment based on an incomplete blueprint.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: The Nikke Rights Committee has come out in protest of Project Matis, calling it an inhuman experiment, and is demanding that it be halted at...
*Beep*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Turn it back on.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You've seen enough. They're not gonna suddenly say anything that's helpful.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... I have to watch.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to see what everyone's saying so I can come up with a plan...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And what plan do you think is gonna come from listening to all that noise?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: F-Father must've been right after all.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That blueprint was never going to work.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This project was doomed from the...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hey, snap out of it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Nothing went wrong in the first round, right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So it doesn't make sense for just the second round to have problems.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Jien told you the board was planning something, didn't she?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Well then they're obviously the ones behind this!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: We need to look again into what happened...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We already checked!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nothing was wrong with the capsules.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Same goes for the body makers.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As soon as it happened, we tore the whole lab apart and found nothing!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You know what that means?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maybe the second round actually went according to spec, and we just got lucky the first time.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The blueprint may have been flawed from the very beginning.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There's no way that's true.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If it were, those who were in the first round wouldn't be performing this well!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And how do you know there's nothing wrong with them?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: S-something could still go wrong.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Their bodies could explode tomorrow, for all we know!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What are you even saying?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It'd be impossible to do research if you only ever assume the worst.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There will always be variables.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So why do you keep insisting it's your blueprint that's the problem?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well, why do you keep insisting it'll be fine?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's what you said this time again!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: But it wasn't fine. We failed again!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Th-that's not...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What, are you going to tell me Father had some ulterior motive again?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How am I supposed to believe that?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You only ever lie to me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You even lied about coming to my inauguration!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Is... that what you've thought this whole time?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: N-no. It just slipped out...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I-I mean, if you'd just left without trying to argue with me,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I wouldn't have said anything...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Are you mad? I'm sorry...
Maxwell's face is pale as she stares at Syuen anxiously watching for her reaction.
She sees the same exact child who, long ago, stood anxiously waiting for Enme to evaluate her blueprint.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're still the exact same...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You haven't grown at all...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You've doubted me this whole time.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What? N-no...! Look, I was just upset and I said something stupid...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You thought I might not actually like you,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: but you needed me to stay close or else you'd feel anxious...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... because you need affection from someone.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That's why he kept me away from your inauguration.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: He needed to keep you anxious.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I had no idea. I just felt bad, so I tried to overcompensate...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Now I get why you're still stuck back in that time...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wh-what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you're not going to make any sense, just leave!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I want to be alone...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why? Are you gonna go run to your hideout once I'm gone?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Cry all you want, and then throw it all away again?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: People are saying you failed. I'm asking if you're going to just believe them and give up again.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... What else am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No matter how hard I work on something, they always put me down. They say I'm a failure, that I'm no good!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If you really worked that hard on it, then fight to protect it!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It doesn't matter if you're anxious and lack confidence. Get ahold of yourself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Take responsibility!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Responsibility...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's your project.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're the one in charge of it. Not just that, but you're the CEO of Missilis!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You can't keep being that child who runs off whenever she's scolded by her dad!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So what do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I looked and looked and couldn't find anything wrong with the project. How am I supposed to believe in myself if...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'll prove it to you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You said this all happened because the blueprint was flawed, right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Well, I don't think your blueprint was flawed at all.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm certain those dirtbags on the board are behind this.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And the reason I know is because there has never, ever been...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: anything wrong with your design!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You still don't seem to realize it,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: but I'm actually a pretty capable researcher.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm going to prove that I'm not wrong about you,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: and that I haven't been lying.
Maxwell rises from her seat.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So, while you sit there sniveling, get ready to apologize to me later,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: you stubborn little baby.
Maxwell leaves.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I talked a big game back there...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... but there really is nothing in the lab.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That must mean the cause isn't anything around the body makers. It's somewhere else entirely...
Maxwell looks around the hallway in the research lab.
With all experiments currently suspended, the deserted hallway is completely quiet.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Where do I even begin...?
Suddenly, she hears a loud series of thumps, followed by a bang.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Wh-what was that sound? There shouldn't be anyone here...
She hears it again.
Maxwell cautiously approaches the source of the sound.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Heroooo Punch, One Hundred Strikes!
Laplace is hammering a sandbag with a flurry of punches.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What're you doing here?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Oh, I've seen you before!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: You're the one in charge of making heroes! Your name was... um...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Maxwell.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's right! Maxwell!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You completely forgot, didn't you?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Anyway, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I'm training!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: To become a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I was told that to become a hero, I have to train every day. No breaks!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: They said it's the only way to get the energy in my body to go up!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah, that is what we wrote in the manual...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But you've actually been sticking to it, even with everything that's going on?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's right! If I'm gonna become a hero, I gotta do it!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Haven't you heard the rumors?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Rumors?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... If you haven't, then never mind.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: You mean that the project might be scrapped, and that even the bodies from the first round might melt at any moment?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh, so you did hear them.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And you stayed anyway?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Yeah! I have to become a hero!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You realize this whole create-a-hero project might be canceled at any moment, right?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Why does that matter?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I've already got a hero body!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's not going to change if the project gets canceled.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: To put it another way, I've already got all I need to become a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: And if I do become a hero, the project can keep going. Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah... I guess you're right, huh?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Haha...! I didn't have to look very far after all.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're the proof! You're proof that Syuen wasn't wrong!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Yup! Syuen's totally right.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: She made this body for me, after all!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Huh? What for?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I thought you were a fake...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But it turns out you're the real thing.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You really are set on becoming a hero.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's right! I'm gonna become a hero!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's another thing Syuen was right about.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If heroes are real, you're exactly the kind of person who should become one.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Looks like I'll have to apologize to Syuen too.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I don't know what for, but definitely apologize!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Phew... This is good. I've found solid proof that the project was a success.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Now I've just gotta search even harder!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Search? For what?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Whatever caused the second round to fail.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm convinced it wasn't Syuen's blueprint. There's got to be something else.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: To put it in terms you'll understand...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There are villains out there sabotaging this project.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: There are?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah, and I have to find proof that they've been interfering.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I don't know where to start,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: but if I keep digging, something's bound to turn up!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: No matter how perfect someone may seem, everyone's bound to have an opening, or something that just sticks out as being suspicious.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Suspicious? Suspicious... Suspicious...

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Oh! There was something!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Gah, you startled me. What do you mean there was something?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Something suspicious!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I saw the person who did the daily injections give the other candidates some strange medicine.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: No one gave us that kind of medicine when I went into the capsule,

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: but I heard the person say that there'd been some change to the experiment and they needed to take the new medicine!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And how exactly did you hear this?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I was passing through the hallway!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Ever since I got this body, I can hear things clearly even from faraway!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you happen to remember where they were handing out that medicine?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Would you look at that...
Maxwell lifts up a medicine container that had been discreetly hidden.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... I can't say for certain this is the cause, but I'm sure we'll find out once I run an analysis.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Thanks for the...

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: *Sniff, sniff!*

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What're you doing...?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I smell something burning!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Something... burning?
Maxwell dashes out into the hallway and looks around.
Smoke is seeping out from the far end of the hall.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What is that...?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: A fire?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But then why isn't the fire alarm going off?
Maxwell looks toward where the smoke is billowing out.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's where the lab...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh no... Run!
*Kaboom!*
